jobs.description: Our vision is to become a leading specialist in staffing services and, through our values, create effective solutions and secure conditions at every stage. Our values are Safety, Engagement, Closeness, and Quality.Eterni has unique expertise and experience in delivering flexible staffing solutions to industries impacted by seasonal fluctuations and a general shortage of qualified labor. In addition to attracting local talent, Eterni also has solid experience in recruiting from abroad.We work every day to be actively involved in each other’s working lives, and through our presence, we aim to foster equality and an inclusive work environment. Eterni provides innovative, competent, and sustainable solutions for both our employees and our customers.We are seeking an experienced Electrician with a minimum of 5 years’ experience in electrical service work. In this role, you will be responsible for a wide range of tasks, from installing and commissioning electrical systems to documenting your completed work.Key Responsibilities:- DSB approval (official authorization from the Norwegian Directorate for Civil Protection, confirming qualifications to perform electrical work in Norway)- At least 5 years of experience in electrical service work- Strong communication skills in English or Norwegian- Good understanding of technical drawings- Valid Class B driver’s licenseAdditional information: Assistance in finding accommodation and support from an HR-consultant is possible
